operator_level_dedup: All German Oxfam Shops operated by Oxfam Deutschland Shops gGmbH count as one legal supplier operator. Multiple Hamburg branches surfaced by CP121 are not counted separately. Oxfam Deutschland e.V. is a separate parent association and is not the retail operator counted here.
reason: Independent PASS2 confirms a current German professional second-hand retail operator. First-party imprint identifies Oxfam Deutschland Shops gGmbH, HRB 57863 and VAT DE176650673; Oxfam's current structure page explicitly states that this wholly-owned gGmbH operates the Oxfam Shops. Current 2026 shop pages document active Hamburg locations with second-hand clothing, shoes and accessories, while the network states it operates at 57 locations. No current item-level remote second-hand apparel catalogue or ordinary delivery of used garments to Spain was established, so the operator is VERIFIED_HOLD rather than ELIGIBLE.
